name: research-skills-openai
description: Academic writing, research workflows, and unified independent scientific evaluation for the OpenAI ecosystem.

interface.shortDescription: Academic writing and reviewed research workflows
interface.longDescription: Write and edit academic prose, develop research ideas, proposals, articles, Perspectives, study improvements, and statistical analysis plans. Includes methodology consultation and unified independent evaluation with explained scores, task readiness, publication consultation, and editorial review. Loads relevant criteria as needed and uses available OpenAI tools. An experimental personal project.
defaultPrompt: Write or edit clear, coherent academic and educational prose.
Develop research ideas, proposals, or manuscripts with independent scientific review.
Compare worthwhile improvements to an existing study and their costs.
Independently evaluate research value, scientific support, and task readiness with clear explanations.
